description: V4-exact relational transformer with a shared-renderer PATCH HEAD (improve of r05 = r00_draft2_v4tfshape; ONE change: the spectral head). Encoder = the incumbent unchanged: 1 global token embedded from (h, p) and 4 resonator tokens embedded by ONE shared GELU MLP from ellipse shape-tensor invariants s = rx+ry, u, v = (rx-ry)cos/sin 2theta, |d| = sqrt(u^2 + v^2 + eps^2), u/|d|, v/|d|, plus h, p; n_layers pre-LN transformer blocks (d_model, 8 heads, GELU FFN 4x, dropout) with learned per-head attention-logit biases per token-pair relation (i XOR j = supercell translation) -> exactly V4-invariant
model_repr:
V4RelTransformerPatchHead(
  (res_embed): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=8, out_features=320, bias=True)
    (1): GELU(approximate='none')
    (2): Linear(in_features=320, out_features=320, bias=True)
  )
  (glob_embed): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=2, out_features=320, bias=True)
    (1): GELU(approximate='none')
    (2): Linear(in_features=320, out_features=320, bias=True)
  )
  (blocks): ModuleList(
    (0-3): 4 x Block(
      (n1): LayerNorm((320,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
      (att): RelAttention(
        (qkv): Linear(in_features=320, out_features=960, bias=True)
        (proj): Linear(in_features=320, out_features=320, bias=True)
      )
      (n2): LayerNorm((320,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
      (ff): Sequential(
        (0): Linear(in_features=320, out_features=1280, bias=True)
        (1): GELU(approximate='none')
        (2): Linear(in_features=1280, out_features=320, bias=True)
      )
      (drop): Dropout(p=0.02, inplace=False)
    )
  )
  (norm): LayerNorm((320,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
  (trunk): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=640, out_features=1536, bias=True)
    (1): GELU(approximate='none')
    (2): Dropout(p=0.02, inplace=False)
    (3): Linear(in_features=1536, out_features=4096, bias=True)
  )
  (patch_blocks): ModuleList(
    (0-1): 2 x PatchBlock(
      (n): LayerNorm((128,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
      (ff): Sequential(
        (0): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=512, bias=True)
        (1): GELU(approximate='none')
        (2): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=128, bias=True)
      )
      (drop): Dropout(p=0.02, inplace=False)
    )
  )
  (patch_norm): LayerNorm((128,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
  (render): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
)
